name: Necromorphic Illumination
body:
School necromancy [light]; Level antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 2, death mage 1, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target 30-ft. burst.
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause all the undead in the burst to be limned with ghostly blue light. They glow light torches, and take a -20 penalty to Stealth checks. The undead cannot benefit from concealment from darkness, blur, displacement, invisibility, or similar effects.
